title: Know whether a review decision still applies
statement: As a developer reviewing an evolving change, I can see whether each decision still applies and why it does not so I know which feedback must be revisited.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A decision is shown as current when its reviewed slide and referenced code have not changed at the review head.
If the slide or code referenced by the slide changes after the decision, the decision is shown out of date with a reason naming what changed.
If the decision commit or current review head cannot be read, the decision is shown with unknown currency and a diagnostic instead of being presented as current.
